title: A linear map fixing an n-plane fixes every unit orientation of that plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P and ξ ∈ Λₙ(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors) a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: ξ = ±τ₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ τₙ, i.e. ⟨β, ξ⟩ = ±β(τ₁, …, τₙ) for all n-covectors β, for an orthonormal family τ spanning Q, with one fixed sign). Let L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map with Lv = v for every v ∈ Q. Then ⟨α ∘ ΛⁿL, ξ⟩ = ⟨α, ξ⟩ for every n-covector α, where (α ∘ ΛⁿL)(w₁, …, wₙ) = α(Lw₁, …, Lwₙ) is α.compContinuousLinearMap L.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ v ∈ Q, L v = v) → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L) = ξ α
